metadata.description: Verified, traceable biomedical safety rules for representative benchmark drugs in the local dataset.
metadata.disclaimer: Educational & research decision-support prototype only. Absence of a local rule does NOT establish clinical safety.

allergies.notes: Angioedema and cross-reactivity with ACE inhibitor class.
Celecoxib contains a sulfonamide moiety; contraindicated in sulfa allergy.
NSAID-induced asthma, urticaria, or allergic reactions.
Anaphylactoid reactions, bronchospasm in aspirin/NSAID-sensitive patients.
Severe hypersensitivity and cross-reactivity with other NSAIDs.
Aspirin-exacerbated respiratory disease (AERD) and anaphylactoid shock.
Severe allergic reactions to macrolide antibiotics.
Severe anaphylactic reactions to quinolone class.
Hypersensitivity to metoprolol and related beta-adrenergic antagonists.
Statin hypersensitivity and immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy.
Opioid hypersensitivity, severe respiratory depression, and anaphylaxis.
Severe histamine release, bronchospasm, and opioid anaphylaxis.

interactions.interaction_mechanism: Combined vitamin K antagonism and platelet COX-1 inhibition significantly increases risk of major gastrointestinal and intracranial hemorrhage.
interactions.clinical_action: Avoid concurrent use unless strictly clinically monitored with frequent INR testing.
interactions.source: FDA SPL / DailyMed: Warfarin Black Box Warning

interactions.interaction_mechanism: NSAIDs competitively displace warfarin from protein binding sites and inhibit platelet aggregation, markedly elevating bleeding risk.
Dual inhibition of hemostasis and direct gastric mucosal injury lead to severe upper GI hemorrhage.
interactions.clinical_action: Avoid combination; monitor PT/INR closely if unavoidable.
interactions.source: FDA SPL / DailyMed: Naproxen Drug Interactions

interactions.interaction_mechanism: Ciprofloxacin inhibits hepatic CYP1A2/CYP3A4 metabolism of warfarin, inducing marked INR prolongation and severe bleeding.
interactions.clinical_action: Monitor INR frequently; adjust warfarin dosage or select alternative antibiotic.
interactions.source: FDA SPL / DailyMed: Ciprofloxacin Drug Interactions

interactions.interaction_mechanism: ACE inhibition decreases aldosterone secretion, impairing renal potassium excretion; potassium supplementation precipitates life-threatening hyperkalemia and cardiac arrest.
interactions.clinical_action: Avoid concomitant potassium supplementation unless close serum potassium monitoring is maintained.

interactions.interaction_mechanism: Concomitant potassium-sparing diuretic and ACE inhibitor causes additive potassium retention leading to severe hyperkalemia.
interactions.clinical_action: Monitor serum electrolytes and renal function frequently.

interactions.interaction_mechanism: NSAID inhibition of renal prostaglandins attenuates antihypertensive effect of ACE inhibitors and increases risk of acute renal deterioration.
interactions.clinical_action: Monitor blood pressure and renal function; ensure patient hydration.
interactions.source: FDA SPL / DailyMed: Lisinopril Drug Interactions

interactions.interaction_mechanism: Angiotensin II receptor blockade reduces aldosterone levels, leading to potassium accumulation; potassium supplementation risks severe hyperkalemia.
interactions.clinical_action: Avoid routine potassium supplementation; monitor serum potassium.

interactions.interaction_mechanism: Concurrent SSRI and tramadol use increases central serotonin activity and lowers seizure threshold, precipitating Serotonin Syndrome.
interactions.clinical_action: Avoid combination or monitor closely for signs of serotonin toxicity (tremor, hyperreflexia, hyperthermia).

interactions.interaction_mechanism: Fluoxetine inhibits CYP2D6 metabolism of tramadol and exerts additive serotonergic effects, significantly increasing seizure and serotonin syndrome risks.
Additive serotonergic effects increase the risk of Serotonin Syndrome and seizures.
SNRI combined with tramadol causes potent serotonin reuptake inhibition, creating high risk for Serotonin Syndrome.
Fluoxetine is a potent CYP2D6 inhibitor, substantially increasing plasma metoprolol concentrations and enhancing bradycardia and heart block risks.
interactions.clinical_action: Reduce metoprolol dose and monitor heart rate and ECG.
interactions.source: FDA SPL / DailyMed: Toprol-XL Drug Interactions

interactions.interaction_mechanism: Amlodipine increases systemic exposure to simvastatin via CYP3A4 competition, increasing risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis.
interactions.clinical_action: Limit simvastatin dosage to a maximum of 20 mg daily when prescribed with amlodipine.
interactions.source: FDA Drug Safety Communication: Simvastatin Drug Interactions

interactions.interaction_mechanism: NSAIDs decrease renal tubular clearance of methotrexate, causing toxic systemic accumulation, fatal bone marrow suppression, and severe GI toxicity.
interactions.clinical_action: Avoid NSAIDs in patients receiving moderate-to-high dose methotrexate.
interactions.source: FDA SPL / DailyMed: Methotrexate Black Box Warning

interactions.interaction_mechanism: Naproxen reduces methotrexate renal excretion, precipitating severe methotrexate toxicity and pancytopenia.
Ibuprofen competitively interferes with the irreversible antiplatelet effect of low-dose aspirin, reducing aspirin's cardioprotective efficacy.
interactions.clinical_action: Take ibuprofen at least 8 hours before or 30 minutes after immediate-release aspirin.
interactions.source: FDA Drug Safety Communication: Ibuprofen and Aspirin

interactions.interaction_mechanism: Clarithromycin strongly inhibits CYP3A4, elevating atorvastatin exposure by several-fold and increasing risk of severe rhabdomyolysis and acute renal failure.
interactions.clinical_action: Avoid combination or withhold atorvastatin therapy during clarithromycin course.

contraindications.reason: Black Box Warning: ACE inhibitors act directly on renin-angiotensin system, causing oligohydramnios, severe fetal renal damage, skeletal deformities, and fetal death.
contraindications.source: FDA SPL: Lisinopril Black Box Warning

contraindications.reason: Boxed Warning: Fetotoxicity and neonatal morbidity/death. Discontinue immediately when pregnancy is detected.
Known teratogen causing fetal warfarin syndrome, nasal hypoplasia, stippled epiphyses, and fatal fetal hemorrhage.
Cholesterol and other products of cholesterol biosynthesis are essential for fetal development; statins risk fetal harm.
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors are contraindicated during pregnancy due to potential fetal toxicity.
Nonselective COX inhibition decreases gastroprotective prostaglandins, precipitating severe GI ulceration, hemorrhage, and perforation.
High risk of life-threatening gastrointestinal bleeding and perforation in patients with active peptic ulceration.
Boxed Warning: Contraindicated for perioperative pain management in CABG surgery due to elevated risk of myocardial infarction and stroke.
Beta-1 blockade decreases sinus node discharge rate, risking profound cardiogenic shock and cardiac arrest.
Depression of atrioventricular conduction can induce complete heart block or severe asystole.
Contraindicated in severe renal failure (eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m2) due to dangerous accumulation and high mortality lactic acidosis.
Salicylate administration in pediatric patients with fever/viral infection (chickenpox or flu) is strongly associated with Reye syndrome.
contraindications.source: FDA SPL / CDC: Aspirin in Pediatric Viral Illness

contraindications.reason: Fluoroquinolones cause arthropathy and articular cartilage erosion in weight-bearing joints in juvenile animal and pediatric studies.
Tetracyclines deposit in calcium during odontogenesis, causing permanent yellow-gray tooth discoloration and enamel hypoplasia.
Bupropion significantly lowers the epileptic seizure threshold in a dose-dependent manner; strictly contraindicated in seizure disorders.
Boxed Warning: Contraindicated in all children younger than 12 years of age due to life-threatening respiratory depression and death.
